title: StaleBench: Isolating Stale Retrieval in Agent Memory, and Pricing the Fix
abstract: arXiv:2611.19752v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An agent that stores facts over time eventually stores several versions of the same fact. Asked a value-agnostic question - "which team does X play for now?" - a similarity retriever cannot prefer the current version, because every version matches the entity the query names. StaleBench isolates this stale-retrieval failure on 892 real updating facts, with currency labels from the source (Wikidata validity years via TempLAMA), never from a retrieval score. Our central result is that retrieval metrics can rank memory policies backwards: a retention policy and its retain-everything control return the identical statement at rank 1 for every test query, yet differ by 29.5 and 65.6 points in reader accuracy on two readers when no date is shown. Contamination@5, the metric we add, ranks them correctly where current@1 and current@5 do not. Withdrawing the lexical anchor that statements carry costs deployed keying mechanisms tens of points of f

translated_title: StaleBench：隔离智能体内存中的过期检索问题，并为修复方案定价
translated_abstract: 一个随时间存储事实的智能体，最终会存储同一事实的多个版本。当被问及一个与具体数值无关的问题——“X现在效力于哪支球队？”——相似度检索器无法优先选择当前版本，因为每个版本都与查询中提到的实体相匹配。StaleBench在892个真实更新的事实上隔离了这种“过期检索”失败问题，其时效性标签来自数据源本身（通过TempLAMA获取的Wikidata有效期年份），而非来自检索分数。我们的核心发现是：检索指标可能对内存策略做出完全相反的排序——某个保留策略与其“保留一切”的对照策略在每个测试查询的排名第一处返回完全相同的陈述，但在不显示日期的情况下，两者在两个阅读器上的准确率分别相差29.5分和65.6分。我们新增的指标Contamination@5能够在current@1和current@5失效的情况下正确地对它们进行排序。撤除陈述所携带的词汇锚点，会使已部署的键控机制付出数十分的代价。
tldr: StaleBench基准在892个真实更新事实上隔离了智能体内存中的“过期检索”失败问题，揭示现有检索指标可能对内存策略做出完全相反的排序，并提出新指标Contamination@5来正确评估和定价修复方案。
en_tdlr: StaleBench isolates stale-retrieval failures in agent memory across 892 real updating facts, revealing that retrieval metrics can rank memory policies backwards, and introduces the Contamination@5 metric to correctly price the fix.
